title: Snapshot Debugging vs AL Profiler in Business Central — When to Use Each

chapters.title: AL Profiling Introduction and Use Cases
AL CPU Profile File and Navigation

features.name: Snapshot Debugging
features.description: A debugging method based on snapshots that allows developers to capture a session, set snap points, and navigate through code execution to analyze errors. Initialized with F7 and finished with Alt F7.
caveats: Based on first session that connects if no session ID or user ID specified

features.name: AL Profiling
features.description: A performance profiling method used to identify and analyze bottlenecks in code by capturing function call timings and generating an ALCPU profile file that links back to source code.
caveats: Not for error debugging but for performance bottlenecks
Requires downloading and importing profile file into VS Code

features.name: AL CPU Profile File Format
features.description: A file with extension ALCPU profile that contains a succession of function calls with timing information, showing which function calls took longer and providing links to the responsible code.

features.name: Performance Profiler
features.description: A tool accessible via 'Analyze Performance' that captures performance data for the current user session, allowing minimization of the window to profile live processes.
caveats: Only captures current user session when logged in

features.name: Scheduled Profiler
features.description: A profiling method accessible via 'Analyze Performance with Scheduled Profiler' that allows monitoring of other user sessions by specifying username, start time, and end time.
caveats: Requires specifying start and end time window
